title: Leaderboard
description: A leaderboard ranks participants based on performance, creating a clear, competitive snapshot of who’s leading. It motivates improvement, highlights top achievers, and brings transparency to progress across games, learning, or productivity challenges.

title: Skill Mapping
description: Skill mapping is the process of identifying, organizing, and aligning an individual’s or team’s skills with current and future roles. It helps organizations understand strengths, uncover gaps, plan targeted training, improve performance, and ensure the right talent is placed in the right role at the right time.
